name: Pause/Resume Demo
description: Interactive demonstration of scenario pause and resume functionality

steps.content: Hi! I'd like to learn about scenario pause/resume.

steps.pauseMessage: Notice the Pause/Resume buttons in the scenario indicator above. This scenario will now pause to let you examine them. Click Resume when ready to continue.
steps.annotation: First pause - showing user the pause/resume UI

steps.content: Great! Now I understand the buttons. What else can you show me?
That's interesting! Tell me more about transparency.

steps.pauseMessage: Take your time to read the explanation above. You can also try clicking the Pause button manually during a running scenario. Click Resume when you're ready to complete this demo.
steps.annotation: Second pause - encouraging user to explore manual pause

steps.content: Thank you for the demo! This pause feature is very helpful.
